main_text.p: Sbhnnengqn, Tempora capitis] Hoc Sax. prifcis Ƨuhpenʒan; modernis autem, ut mihi author est Martinius, in Etymolog. Ꝺuennunge, & Ꝺuenne.
- Sbto Femur. Nos Ꝺtø] Sax. Ꞓeoþ; nos tbtgb.

Sburtbtc, Egenus ! & thurtegtn, egeno] Scribendum forte thurfbtc, & thurtegtn. Teut. enim egenus, indigus, olim Ꝺoiftigb, Ꝺurftigb; hodie (littera r. transpofita) Ꝺioftigb, Ꝺuftigb, Sax. eodem sensu, Ꞓeanþ.
Sbutoe, Ancillæ: & thutwon, & thiutwon, idem] Hoc Sax. Ꞓeopins, & Ꞓeopne.

Crego, Dolor: & tregon, dolore: & trege, dolores: & tregbaff, dolens] Tribulare, Saxon. τρέχιαh. Hinc (forte) parturientis fœminæ dolores, nobis tbiotwes: nisi malis à Ꞓpopian, quod Sax. pati sonat, unde Salvatoris nostri passio Ꞓpopunʒe dicta.
Srtambon, Tubæ. Nos (trompen] Vide supra, Ꝺtambon.

page.notes: Dense black-letter Saxon glosses are read approximately; many words are doubtful and marked only where clearly uncertain in running text. Small marginal marks at right and left edges (ornaments, reference signs) are not transcribed as text. Bottom centre mark is a catchmark/ornament, not text.
